milestoneReview.normalizationNotes: Base values are inferred from rounded displays, not read as unrounded game values. Account bonuses apply once to each owner's milestones; Grand Master and tile strength then share the confirmed additive pool. Effective bonuses retain fractions. Captain's Power Mage Energy base of 10 is conditional on the same scaling rule and remains flagged; named skill effects are visible but unscored.
